title: Annual Capital Gains Tax Return for Onerous Transfer of Shares of Stock Not Traded Through the Local Stock Exchange

choice_rows.label: Item 12 — Availing of tax relief under Special Law or International Tax Treaty?

validation.how: Errors render only in the 'Needs review' list after all sections; the failing caption turns red and Queue for submission is disabled with no text beside it.

findings.now: Schedules 1 and 2 each show ten fixed rows, and an entry past row ten cannot be recorded.
findings.why: The official schedules are unbounded (rules/forms/1707a-v2021/README.md:3) and the model allows 40 rows (form_1707a.rs:37), but the page and read_inputs stop at ten (form_1707a_view.rs:60, 436-475), so the return cannot be completed here and stored rows past ten are dropped on the next edit.

options.name: Add and remove rows
options.detail: Let the user add rows past ten and delete blank ones, up to the model's 40-row limit.

options.name: More pop-up
options.detail: Keep rows 1 to 4 on the page and open a pop-up for the rest, mirroring the official 'More' list.

findings.now: The upload writes the email in capitals, so a lower-case address reaches BIR as upper case.
findings.why: The official layout flags txtI11Email uppercase (crates/bir-core/data/official-xml/1707a-v2021.json:288), which breaks the rule that the email is never upper-cased; the repo's own sample upload shows SAMPLE.TAXPAYER@EXAMPLE.COM (crates/bir-core/tests/sample-payloads/1707A-12312025.plain.xml:26) even though the model passes the typed address through (form_1707a.rs:574).

options.name: Drop the flag
options.detail: Remove uppercase from the txtI11Email parts after checking a real 1707-A upload.

options.name: Record an exception
options.detail: If real 1707-A uploads are capitalised, keep the flag and document 1707-A as the one form whose email the official app capitalises.

findings.now: Year ended is editable, but the dashboard row and the draft still use the year from the library tile.
findings.why: taxable_year() returns the tile year (form_1707a.rs:1082-1084), while the file name and XML use the typed year end (form_1707a.rs:1089-1094), so the saved row and the filed period can disagree.

options.name: Lock to tile year
options.detail: Make the year read-only, since the library tile already sets it (form_1707a.rs:289).

options.name: Key by year ended
options.detail: Derive the draft's year from the typed year end so the list and the file agree.

findings.now: The printed 1707-A sheet shows no email.
findings.why: The email shares the contact-number comb with no join of its own on the frozen sheet (html-frozen/1707a-2021/writer-cells.json:500), so the print preview drops it.

options.name: Join the email cell
options.detail: Map the email to its own cell on the sheet so the preview fills it.

options.name: Combined line
options.detail: Print the contact number and email together in the shared comb so both are visible.
